description: Tier 3 v4 search-only reference inventory for lexical recurrence, phrase searches, negative checks, source-context review, and future candidate promotion. Reference records are not fully annotated evidence and must not enter Stage 4 interpretive counts unless promoted into validation or core tiers through a later issue.

source_files.notes: Reference records continue deterministic IDs after the v4 core and validation inventory ranges.
Source authority register used for reference-corpus discovery and provenance notes.
Tier definitions used to keep the reference corpus distinct from core and validation evidence.

documents.title: Protest in the Illinois Legislature on the Subject of Slavery
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Protest in the Illinois Legislature on the Subject of Slavery, March 3, 1837.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only record for early slavery vocabulary and legislative framing; item-level URL and checksum remain future provenance work.
documents.selection_rationale: Provides an early boundary text for search checks around slavery language before the Lyceum Address without expanding the fully annotated denominator.

documents.title: Speech at a Political Discussion in the Hall of the House of Representatives
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Speech at a Political Discussion in the Hall of the House of Representatives, December 26, 1839.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only record for early party rhetoric; not eligible for interpretive counts without promotion.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds early political-register context for lexical searches across speeches that are outside the v4 core selection.

documents.title: Circular from the Whig Committee
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Circular from the Whig Committee, March 4, 1840.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only record with authorship and committee-context caution; promote only after provenance review.
documents.selection_rationale: Supports searches for organizational and party vocabulary that may contextualize public-speech patterns.

documents.title: Letter to Williamson Durley
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Letter to Williamson Durley, October 3, 1845.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only record for private antebellum search context.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds a private-letter search target around political judgment and slavery before the main antebellum core texts.

documents.title: Resolutions in the United States House of Representatives
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Resolutions in the United States House of Representatives, December 22, 1847.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only congressional record useful for war-powers vocabulary checks.
documents.selection_rationale: Provides a pre-Civil War war-powers comparison point without requiring full Stage 4 annotation.

documents.title: Speech in United States House of Representatives: The War with Mexico
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Speech in United States House of Representatives: The War with Mexico, January 12, 1848.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only congressional speech for search comparison; not part of the validation denominator.
documents.selection_rationale: Supports phrase and negative checks against Lincoln's earlier congressional war rhetoric.

documents.title: Notes for a Law Lecture
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Notes for a Law Lecture, approximately 1850.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only fragment with approximate date; use for discovery and negative checks only.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds professional/legal vocabulary for boundary searches outside public political texts.

documents.title: Fragment on Government
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Fragment on Government, approximately 1854.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only fragment with approximate date; promotion requires source and text-status review.
documents.selection_rationale: Supports searches around government, labor, and political-theory vocabulary adjacent to the Peoria-era core.

documents.title: Speech at Bloomington, Illinois
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Speech at Bloomington, Illinois, May 29, 1856.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only record with substantial text-integrity caution; searches may identify candidate language but cannot support claims without promotion and review.
documents.selection_rationale: Keeps the famous but textually risky Bloomington material available for discovery without treating it as secure core evidence.

documents.title: Fragment on the Sectional Controversy
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Fragment on the Sectional Controversy, approximately 1856.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only fragment with approximate date; useful for lexical discovery but not for aggregate interpretation.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds antebellum sectional-language context between Peoria, Dred Scott, and the 1858 campaign materials.

documents.title: Letter to Theodore Canisius
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Letter to Theodore Canisius, May 17, 1859.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only public-letter record for immigration, party, and political-rights search context.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds a distinct antebellum public-letter search target that is not already selected for the core or validation tiers.

documents.title: Autobiography Written for Jesse W. Fell
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Autobiography Written for Jesse W. Fell, December 20, 1859.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only autobiographical record; promotion would require deciding whether self-presentation belongs in validation or core evidence.
documents.selection_rationale: Supports searches for self-fashioning and campaign biography language near the 1860 threshold.

documents.title: Autobiography Written for John L. Scripps
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Autobiography Written for John L. Scripps, June 1860.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only autobiographical record with month-level date precision.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds a second campaign-biographical reference point for search-only comparison with public political argument.

documents.title: Letter to Alexander H. Stephens
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Letter to Alexander H. Stephens, December 22, 1860.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only secession-crisis private correspondence; not counted with core speeches or public letters.
documents.selection_rationale: Supports searches for secession-crisis constitutional reassurance outside public inaugural rhetoric.

documents.title: Letter to Cuthbert Bullitt
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Letter to Cuthbert Bullitt, July 28, 1862.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only public-letter record for emancipation and reconstruction-policy search context.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds a distinct Louisiana-policy search target without duplicating a validation inventory record.

documents.title: Letter to Horatio Seymour
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Letter to Horatio Seymour, August 7, 1863.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only public-letter record for civil-liberties and dissent-context searches.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds a distinct wartime public-letter search target for civil-liberties vocabulary and negative checks.

documents.title: Order of Retaliation
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Order of Retaliation, July 30, 1863.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only military/legal text for search checks involving Black soldiers and wartime retaliation policy.
documents.selection_rationale: Adds search-only context for military policy vocabulary that may inform later validation selection.

documents.title: Response to a Serenade
documents.source_citation: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, Response to a Serenade, July 7, 1863.
documents.provenance_notes: Reference-only reported public response; wording and span boundaries require caution before any promotion.
documents.selection_rationale: Supports searches for informal public rhetoric and reception language without treating reported remarks as fully annotated evidence.
